name: @theoremai/agents
description: A flat TypeScript agent kernel for typed profiles, deterministic turn execution, registered tools, provider adapters, guardrails, and host-injected traces.

scripts.coverage: rm -rf coverage && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-env --allow-sys --allow-run --ignore=npm/ --coverage=coverage tests/ && deno coverage coverage --lcov --output=coverage/lcov.info && node scripts/lcov-to-istanbul.mjs
scripts.check:react: npm --prefix react ci && npm --prefix react run typecheck && npm --prefix react run theme:check
scripts.lint:fallow: npm run coverage && fallow audit --base "${FALLOW_AUDIT_BASE:-origin/main}" --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json
scripts.lint:fallow:deep: fallow health && fallow dupes && fallow dead-code
scripts.lint: npm run lint:docs && deno lint && npm run lint:biome && npm run lint:ast-grep && npm run lint:fallow
scripts.check:ci: npm run lint:docs && deno lint && npm run lint:biome && npm run lint:ast-grep && deno task verify:publish && npm run lint:fallow && deno check mod.ts tests/fixtures/probes/ scripts/*.ts && npm run check:react && deno task test
